prompt: In the style of a cinematic film still, the scene captures the chaotic energy of a busy restaurant kitchen. On the left, a chef in a white toque stands tall, his arms crossed firmly over his chest while he looks sternly at a line cook in a blue apron who is chopping onions with rapid precision. Next to the line cook, a silver pot sits on the stove, steam rising visibly from its lid. In the center, a waiter in a black vest holds a tray aloft, balancing three wine glasses that gleam under the harsh lights. Beside him, a sous chef in a green bandana points urgently at a ticket rail, her expression tense as she shouts orders. A stainless steel counter separates them from the prep area, where a bowl of fresh lettuce rests near a cutting board stained with juice. To the right, a dishwasher in rubber gloves scrubs a large pan, water splashing onto the floor tiles. Behind him, a stack of clean plates leans precariously against the wall. Near the pass, a manager in a suit checks his wristwatch, his posture rigid and impatient. A small cat with orange fur sits calmly on a high shelf above the fridge, observing the chaos below without moving. Next to the cat, a hanging ladle dangles from a rack, catching the light. In the foreground, a bottle of olive oil stands next to a jar of dried herbs, both slightly out of focus. A ticket printer spits out a long strip of paper, curling onto the floor near the manager's polished shoes. There is no window visible in the background, keeping the focus entirely on the interior labor. There is no sunlight entering the room, only the artificial glow of overhead fixtures illuminating the sweat on the workers' brows.
